change_scope: Reduce the luminance of persistent browser controls, outline the dark takeover button, and periodically shift small marks within fixed touch targets.

release_checks.upgrade_install: Updated the production app in place from 1.0.3 (14) to 1.0.4 (15). The first installation time was preserved and the on-device base APK matched the release APK.

feature_verification.build: Debug instrumentation on Android 14 hardware using local synthetic webpages
feature_verification.coverage: Both toolbar palettes, contrast and pressed states, badge containment, tab number alignment, original hit targets, native video scrolling and theme changes on the same page. A separate real-time run tapped the local page roughly every two seconds for over a minute. Hardware-composited window crops confirmed that WS and the menu glyph moved while their touch bounds stayed fixed.

inherited_baseline.scope: The transfer, HLS conversion and shared-cache implementations are unchanged. Their dedicated device suites were not rerun for this browser chrome patch.
